rules.statement: The SoC integrator shall supply the i_clk_core clock frequency/period and uncertainty before static timing analysis.
No clock-domain crossing exceptions are required; the bridge, AHB, AXI and FIFOs use one synchronous clock domain.

rules.condition: timing constraints between bridge logic and FIFO pointers
rules.statement: Asynchronous clock groups or false paths must not be declared between bridge logic and FIFO pointers.
Only justified reset, generated-clock or memory-macro constraints supplied by the selected library and SoC flow shall be applied; no numeric exception is invented.
The synchronous FIFO storage must be mapped to standard cells or a compatible single-clock memory macro.
